data.name: Project: Orc
data.detailed_description:
PROJECT ORC

Live the life of an Orc in a brutal world of war, survival, and tribal conquest.

Project Orc is a brutal open-world survival RPG where you rise through the ranks of your clan to become the War-Chief. Gather resources, craft powerful gear, build your clan stronghold, and conquer a savage world filled with rival tribes, dangerous creatures, and ancient secrets.

EXPLORE A SAVAGE WORLD

Venture across a dangerous open world filled with distinct regions, hostile enemies, hidden dungeons, and ancient ruins. Hunt deadly beasts, uncover lost places, and complete quests that shape your journey through the brutal world of the Orcs.

Tame powerful creatures and ride epic mounts to travel the wild lands and dominate the battlefield.

BUILD YOUR CLAN STRONGHOLD

Claim land and build a powerful Orc settlement. Construct war camps, crafting halls, and fortified strongholds to defend your clan from rival tribes and invading enemies.

Recruit Orc clan members to gather resources, work your settlement, or fight beside you in battle as your clan grows stronger.

FORGE YOUR WARRIOR

Create your own combat style by combining battle masteries, talents, and abilities. Learn powerful skills, craft brutal weapons and armor, and develop a warrior build that suits your path to power.

Master brutal action combat where strength, timing, and skill decide who survives.

GATHER, CRAFT AND CONQUER

Survive in a harsh world by gathering resources, crafting equipment, preparing food, and forging powerful gear. Discover new crafting recipes as you explore, defeat enemies, and uncover rare materials.

Grow stronger, expand your clan, and conquer the surrounding lands.

KEY FEATURES

  • A vast open world filled with dangerous enemies, unique regions, dungeons, and secrets to discover

  • Brutal action combat focused on timing, skill, and powerful weapons

  • Deep character progression with talents, battle masteries, and customizable builds

  • Clan settlement building where you construct strongholds and expand your tribe

  • Recruitable Orc clan members who gather resources or fight beside you

  • Tame beasts and ride epic mounts across the wild lands

  • Quests and exploration that reveal the story and secrets of the world

  • Single-player campaign and multiplayer servers where clans rise and fall

data.short_description: Enter a brutal open-world survival RPG as an Orc and rise from a lowly warrior to War-Chief. Gather resources, craft gear, build clan strongholds, raid enemies, and conquer a savage tribal world shaped by war, survival, and power.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-4370
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 55 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 6700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3500x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 or AMD RX Vega-56
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 55 GB available space
